Lately, it’s been harder to focus. I’ll sit down to write and forget what I was even planning to say, or I’ll misplace my notes, my phone, my coffee—little things, but it’s constant. I blame it on my foggy head.  

Now and then, there are these bursts—maybe a few days where I sleep less, talk faster, jump between five ideas at once, full of energy. I’ll write like crazy, convinced I’m onto something brilliant. But it never lasts, and it’s not like I’ve been reckless or unable to function... just different. Then it fades, and I’m back in this low hum. It’s messy. I can’t tell if it’s all just one long slump... or if something else is flickering under the surface.
